journey.name: Cancel And Delete Subscription
journey.description:
Terminal actions on both sides. The payer cancels an active subscription from its detail screen and the creator deletes a still-pending proposal. Both confirmations are swipe controls with a brand orange knob; the payer sees the cross illustration and the creator the trash illustration.
Deletion needs its own subscription rather than the one just cancelled: the creator's Delete button is gated on the subscription still being proposed or active, so a cancellation reaching the creator removes it. A proposal with no paid periods also leaves CREATED once deleted, whereas one that has taken a payment stays there to retain its history, and once canceled keeps its place until the paid period ends, then moves to EXPIRED.

actions.action: Launch the E2E Bitkit app with an active subscription the payer accepted, per review-and-subscribe.xml
Have the creator send a second proposal, "Journey Sub Two", and leave it unaccepted so it stays pending with no paid periods
On the payer instance, open the drawer menu, tap Subscriptions, and tap the active "Journey Sub" row
Verify the detail footer shows Cancel carrying the cross icon, alongside More Info when the subscription has a description
Verify the sheet title reads "Cancel Subscription", the cross illustration is shown, and the swipe control reads "Swipe To Cancel"
Swipe the confirm control to the end
Verify the sheet dismisses and the "Journey Sub" detail shows STATUS "Active", the timing cell "EXPIRES" with the end date of the paid period, and the footer shows More Info without Cancel
Navigate back and verify the Subscriptions list shows "Journey Sub" in the ACTIVE section with "Expires" and the end date of the paid period as its subtitle
Tap the "Journey Sub" row and verify its detail opens again
Switch to the creator instance and open Subscriptions

Verify "Journey Sub" is still listed under CREATED with "Expires" and the end date of the paid period as its subtitle, because its paid periods are retained as history until that period ends, when it moves to EXPIRED
Tap the pending "Journey Sub Two" row in the CREATED section
Verify the detail shows SUBSCRIBERS and PAYMENTS cells, that PAYMENTS uses the coins icon, and that the footer Delete button carries the trash icon
Verify the sheet title reads "Delete Subscription?", the trash illustration is shown, and the swipe control reads "Swipe To Delete"
Swipe the confirm control to the end
Verify the sheet dismisses and "Journey Sub Two", having taken no payment, leaves the CREATED section
